description: Install dependencies for a foundry project (forge install)

dependencies.description: Dependencies to install, e.g. ['OpenZeppelin/openzeppelin-contracts', 'transmissions11/solmate']. If omitted, installs all existing dependencies from foundry.toml.

noCommit.description: If true, passes --no-commit to skip creating a git commit for the install

projectPath.description: Absolute path to the foundry project directory

name: install
